settings.heading: Refund Policy
settings.content:
Last updated: May 2026 — a starting template, review with legal counsel before launch.

90-day guarantee

Single jars may be returned for a full refund within 90 days of delivery — even if used. Email hello@prairiefatco.example to begin; no need to ship the jar back.

Multi-packs & sets

Unopened additional jars in original packaging may be returned within 30 days.

Processing

Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–10 business days of approval.

Non-refundable

  • Gift cards
  • Final-sale items
